title: Someone to Watch Over Me, after Rod Stewart

details.title: Someone to Watch Over Me
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet. In his key, E, an octave up it would reach A♭5, so it is in E♭, a half step lower: concert D♭4 to G5 (written E♭4 to A5).
facts: Someone to Watch Over Me, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, read note by note and straightened
E♭ concert, F for the trumpet
The song as Rod sings it, with rests where the band plays alone
